items.q: Why was the local Ollama service slow on localhost?
items.a: The committed Project Edge Node benchmark attributes excess latency to IPv6-first localhost resolution. Switching local Ollama communication to 127.0.0.1 reduced reported mean request latency from 5.356 seconds to 0.973 seconds. The report records 50 latency requests with zero failures, plus a separate 10-request time-to-first-token measurement; results depend on that environment.
